source: Bare mention assumes one standard 250ml glass -- the same glass volume already used to derive nutrients.json's smoothie record, and the implicit default the old FoodEstimator baked into its 'fruit smoothie' whole-item figure. Without this rule, 'smoothie'/'fruit smoothie' with no container word has no resolvable volume and reports no nutrition data (the regression this restores).
